description: The user's business as AccountsOS holds it: each company's country, type of business, registration number, VAT registration and whether Finn covers its country, with the default one marked (for an accountancy practice, its clients). Call this first after the user connects, and use its country and type in every answer from then on. When there is more than one company, pass `company` to the other tools.
name: list_companies
title: List Companies
